up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against the target with CHEMBL ID 'CHEMBL3397'. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, literature reference (PubMed ID or DOI), assay description, target name, and target organism. Only include records where the standard relation is '=' (exact values).
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3397'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
